paper_type_evidence.quote: Using the ALMA 7m array we detect compact dust continuum emission towards all targets, and find that fragmentation, at these scales, is limited.

question.value: How do infrared-quiet massive ATLASGAL clumps (d ≤ 4.5 kpc) fragment from 0.3 pc to 0.06 pc scales at an early evolutionary stage?

evidence.quote: We investigate the fragmentation properties from 0.3 pc to 0.06 pc scales of a homogenous sample of infrared-quiet massive clumps within 4.5 kpc selected from the ATLASGAL survey.
This paper makes use of the ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA 2013.1.00960.S.
We used a lowresolution wide-band setup in Band 7, yielding 4 × 1.75 GHz effective bandwidth with a spectral resolution of 976.562 kHz.

findings_qualitative.value: Fragmentation is limited; 77% of clumps host at most 3 compact sources and ~14% remain single.

evidence.quote: 45% of the clumps hosts up to two, while 77% host up to three compact sources.

claims.hypothesis: Massive IR-quiet clumps fragment strongly as expected from thermal Jeans mass
claims.experiment: ALMA 7m continuum source extraction and mass estimates
claims.result: Mean 3 fragments per clump; core masses up to ~400 Msun far exceed Jeans mass ~1 Msun
claims.finding: Fragmentation is limited and not thermal

evidence.loc: 5.1. Limited fragmentation from clump to core scale
evidence.quote: the observed infrared quiet massive clumps exhibit here limited fragmentation with N¯ fr = 3, from clump to core scales.

claims.hypothesis: Turbulence or magnetic fields support the massive cores
claims.experiment: Turbulent Core model and magnetic critical mass estimates
claims.result: Required linewidth ≳6 km/s and B>10 mG at core densities
claims.finding: Lack observational support for sufficient support

evidence.quote: We lack observational support for strong enough turbulence and magnetic field to keep the most massive cores virialized.

claims.hypothesis: Core mass distribution matches the IMF
claims.experiment: Power-law fit with Monte Carlo on Td
claims.finding: Intrinsically shallower unless temperatures scale with brightness or further fragmentation occurs

evidence.quote: constrains the error of the fit suggesting an intrinsically shallower slope than the IMF.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Radiative feedback as limit on fragmentation disfavoured for lack of embedded low-mass protostars

evidence.quote: we lack evidence for a potential deeply embedded population of low-mass protostars needed to heat up the collapsing gas.

limitations_admitted.value: Up to factor of two mass uncertainty from dust temperature
